previous_statement: Obstruction and correction of node 1.8. For W in {U,V}, def-four-corner-merging-datum requires ||T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R|| <= rho, whereas lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer gives only ||T_W(I_{B_W})-u_W|| <= C_out*t for u_W=Co^{A_R}_{P_W^R}(P_W^R). The triangle identity in node 1.7 leaves ||u_W-P_W^R||, and node 1.7.1 correctly records that none of the seven permitted externals bounds this term. In particular, the second estimate of lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison applies only to Y already in S^{A_R}_{P_W^R,P_W^R}; it neither asserts that P_W^R belongs to this compressed range nor compares P_W^R with its compressed unit. Hence node 1.8 is retracted: the root contract is not proved from the permitted inputs. A valid repair requires a separately validated and shard-permitted universal corner-unit estimate ||Co_P(P)-P|| <= K_unit*(delta+epsilon), followed by C_cross >= C_out+K_unit and the corresponding threshold reduction.
new_statement: Obstruction and correction of node 1.8. For W in {U,V}, def-four-corner-merging-datum requires ||T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R|| <= rho, whereas lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer gives only ||T_W(I_{B_W})-u_W|| <= C_out*t for u_W=Co^{A_R}_{P_W^R}(P_W^R). The triangle identity in node 1.7 leaves ||u_W-P_W^R||, and node 1.7.1 correctly records that none of the seven permitted externals bounds this term. In particular, the second estimate of lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison applies only to Y already in S^{A_R}_{P_W^R,P_W^R}; it neither asserts that P_W^R belongs to this compressed range nor compares P_W^R with its compressed unit. Hence node 1.8 is retracted: the root contract is not proved from the permitted inputs. A valid repair requires a separately validated and shard-permitted universal corner-unit estimate ||Co_P(P)-P|| <= K_unit*(delta+epsilon). Since here delta=C_nest*t and epsilon=2*C_ca*t, it would yield ||u_W-P_W^R|| <= K_unit*(C_nest+2*C_ca)*t; one must therefore impose C_cross >= C_out+K_unit*(C_nest+2*C_ca) and e_cross <= e_unit/(C_nest+2*C_ca), in addition to the other ledger bounds.
